critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the 'Main deck window row' geometry by replacing the uniform dot array with a variable-spacing sequence. Implement a parametric distribution where windows are clustered in groups of 4, separated by larger gaps (3x the standard interval) at door locations and the cockpit area. Adjust the 'Upper deck window row' to be an offset duplicate of this sequence, shifted vertically by 15% of the fuselage height to create two distinct rows.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage side.
discrepancies.reference: Two distinct rows of windows (main deck and upper deck) with specific spacing.

discrepancies.observed: No visible upper deck windows or distinct upper deck structure.
discrepancies.reference: A prominent row of windows on the 'hump' section.

discrepancies.observed: No visible door frames or structural breaks in the fuselage skin.
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined main cabin doors and service doors with distinct outlines.

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire length of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Variable spacing with larger gaps around door locations and cockpit area.
